message:
We all have that one friend who has a knack for turning even the smallest hiccup into a full-blown crisis, right? Recently, they called us in a near-panic about a minor storm warning. As we chatted, I couldn’t help but think about how preparedness can actually ease those worries. 

Instead of spiraling into chaos, we shared a few simple tips, like creating a go-bag with essentials and having a family communication plan. 🌧️ It was a gentle reminder that being ready doesn’t mean being fearful—it means feeling a little more secure.

What’s your favorite tip for staying calm and prepared?
